scope: Three-source read-only scout on correction and repeated-error behavior; no model inference or external code execution

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.read_depth: Landing metadata/abstract; selected HTML sections2,3.1-3.3,5,6,7; setup/results and prompt-design discussion; not all appendices
sources.relevant_claim: Intrinsic and external-feedback correction differ; initial-prompt information and inference budgets require controls.
sources.local_limit: Our external tool feedback/operator correction on135M is not a replication of their intrinsic larger-model reasoning study.

sources.title: Teaching Large Language Models to Self-Debug
sources.read_depth: Landing metadata/abstract; selected HTML introduction, sections3,4.2-4.3,5.2.1-5.2.3; not detailed prompt appendices
sources.relevant_claim: Prompted debugging with execution information can help in studied settings; generated explanation traces are not captured internal execution states.
sources.local_limit: Different larger models, demonstrations, tasks and budgets; not the method run in our six attempts.

sources.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
sources.read_depth: Landing metadata/abstract; selected HTML introduction describing method, section4 weaker-model and feedback analyses; AppendixG narrative/examples and H.1 opening; not full1799-line HTML or implementation
sources.relevant_claim: Refinement can succeed under studied prompting but Vicuna13B also repeats or fabricates conversation despite feedback; offered causal explanation is hypothetical.
sources.local_limit: Qualitative analogy, not a135M replication or evidence that size alone explains our behavior.

inferences_not_source_findings: Test the same correction initially versus after a failed example to separate instruction information from correction-history effects.
Keep available feedback, changed text, procedure selection and actual verified effect distinct.
Do not infer hidden understanding or general impossibility from exact-output repetition.
